def average_price(items):
    total_quantity = sum(quantity for quantity, _ in items)
    if total_quantity == 0:
        raise ValueError("Total quantity must be greater than zero")

    total_cost = sum(quantity * unit_price for quantity, unit_price in items)
    return f"{total_cost / total_quantity:.2f}"
